summary: 65-year-old father missing after his raft capsized shortly after launching at Grizzly Creek; his son swam to shore while the father was last seen clinging to the capsized raft drifting downriver. Glenwood Springs Fire searched both banks from the Grizzly Creek rest area to Two Rivers Park, then Garfield County SAR continued the search, suspending it ~8 PM with nightfall; the Sheriff's Office opened a missing-person case.
location: Colorado River at Grizzly Creek rest area, Glenwood Canyon
responding_agency: Garfield County Sheriff's Office; Garfield County Search and Rescue; Glenwood Springs Fire Department
notes: Garfield County SO news release dated 2023-06-26. Son self-rescued and unharmed; victim count is the missing father only. Search suspended at nightfall; no resolution coverage found; outcome assist per unlocated-missing-person precedent (cf id 2827 Yampa missing rafters).
